aboutHeading: Melbourne's Most Experienced Wall & Floor Tilers
aboutText: JM Tiling and Stone has been delivering premium wall and floor tiling solutions across Melbourne, VIC with a customer-oriented approach that ensures every step of your project is monitored from start to finish. Our experienced team uses top-quality materials, professional execution and skilled craftsmanship to deliver results you can be confident in. From bathroom renovations to commercial flooring, we provide a 100% personalised service tailored to meet your exact needs.
servicesSubheading: Expert tiling solutions for every surface
servicesText: JM Tiling and Stone specialises in wall and floor tiling across Melbourne, offering comprehensive services for residential, commercial and industrial projects. Our team handles everything from bathroom renovations to large-scale commercial installations.

services.title: Wall Tiling
services.desc: Expert wall tiling for kitchens, bathrooms and feature walls across Melbourne homes and businesses.

services.title: Floor Tiling
services.desc: Professional floor tiling installation for all surfaces including ceramic, porcelain and natural stone.

services.title: Bathroom Tiling
services.desc: Complete bathroom tiling solutions with waterproofing, tile selection and expert layout design.

services.title: Commercial Tiling
services.desc: Large-scale tiling projects for offices, retail spaces and commercial properties across Melbourne.

services.title: Tile Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Full tile removal services with old surface preparation and fresh installation to your specifications.

services.title: Free Tiling Consultation
services.desc: Comprehensive project assessment covering tile layout, design, finish and the best surface for your needs.

reviews.text: JM Tiling and Stone did a complete bathroom retiling job for our home in Melbourne. The team was professional, tidy and delivered exactly what was promised with no hidden charges. Highly recommend their wall tiling service.

reviews.text: We hired JM Tiling for our office renovation and the floor tiling work was exceptional. They handled a large commercial project on time and the quality of workmanship was outstanding. A truly experienced team.

reviews.text: As a property manager overseeing multiple units in Melbourne, I rely on JM Tiling and Stone for all our tiling needs. Their transparent process, quality products and timely service make them our go-to tiling contractors.
